page.heading: Project context for
page.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} under specs/, docs/ and insights/ on {branch}. Agents read the ones you attach to them.

noClone.title: Repository not cloned yet
noClone.body: DevDigest reads these documents from its local clone of the default branch. Index the repository first.

empty.title: No specs, docs or insights yet
empty.body: Add Markdown under specs/, docs/ or insights/ (in any package) and push it to {branch}. Agents can then attach it in their Context tab.

doc.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Not attached to any agent} one {Used by # agent} other {Used by # agents}}
doc.untrustedNote: Shown as committed on {branch}. In a review it is untrusted data: it can lead to findings, never remove them.
